adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts the code changed from a single calendar reference (`find`) to iterating all references (`filter` + `for (const reference ...)`). Inside the recurring-series branch (`if bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent ...`), it still loops over *all* user calendar credentials and *all* `updatedBookings`, deleting each updated booking’s calendar event (`await calendar?.deleteEvent(uid, ...)`) without using the current `reference` to scope the work. Because this whole recurring delete block now runs once per calendar reference, the same (creds × updatedBookings) deletes are repeated for each reference, causing redundant external API calls and potential repeated deletes/rate-limit/errors.
